cast.dad: the dad: a Korean father in his late 30s, slightly chubby with a round face, short black hair that is clearly thinning on top, thick eyebrows, faint stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a white t-shirt, gray sweatpants and house slippers; a kind but easily flustered look
cast.kid: the kid: an 8-year-old Korean child with a black bowl-cut, huge round curious eyes, one missing front tooth, wearing a red hoodie, navy shorts and white socks; small, fearless and very direct
cast.mom: the mom: a Korean mother in her late 30s, slim with a soft oval face and a fair complexion, a shoulder-length dark brown bob with a side part, one side tucked behind her ear and the ends curling slightly inward, thin silver round wire-frame glasses, calm almond-shaped eyes, wearing a sage-green crew-neck knit sweater, beige wide-leg pants and house slippers; calm, sharp and quietly amused, the one who usually already knows the answer

items.title: 아빠 — 기본
items.note: 아빠의 기준 그림. 이후 아빠 그림에 전부 ②로 첨부한다.
items.desc: 3/4 view, body and face turned slightly to the LEFT. Standing relaxed, arms at his sides, a mild friendly smile.

items.title: 아빠 — 당황
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. He has just been asked a question he cannot answer: eyes darting sideways, forced crooked smile showing teeth, one hand rubbing the back of his neck, cold sweat drops flying off his forehead, knees slightly bent.

items.title: 아빠 — 설명
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Explaining confidently: index finger raised high, chest puffed out, eyebrows up, mouth open mid-sentence, the other hand on his hip.

items.title: 아빠 — 생각
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Deep in thought: one hand on his chin, eyes looking up, lips pursed, one eyebrow raised.

items.title: 아빠 — 뿌듯
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Warm proud smile with closed crescent eyes, both hands on his hips, a small sparkle near his head.

items.title: 아빠 — 충격
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Frozen in shock: eyes bulging out, jaw dropped showing teeth and tongue, hair standing on end, both hands up, shock lines close around his head.

items.title: 아빠 — 몰래 검색
items.note: 편마다 나오는 '그날 밤 몰래 검색' 장면용.
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Sneaking a search at night: hunched over and tiptoeing, holding a smartphone close to his face with both hands, the screen glow lighting his face from below, eyes wide and bloodshot, lips pressed tight, glancing nervously over his shoulder, cold sweat drops.

items.title: 아빠 — 설명 (말하는 그림)
items.motion: 설명 그림과 1/8초마다 번갈아 나와서 입이 움직인다.
items.desc: Change only the face and the raised hand: the mouth is now closed in a confident smile (as if between two words) and the raised index finger is tilted a few degrees forward.

items.title: 아이 — 기본
items.note: 아이의 기준 그림. 이후 아이 그림에 전부 ②로 첨부한다.
items.desc: 3/4 view, body and face turned slightly to the RIGHT. Standing with hands behind the back, head tilted, a bright curious smile.

items.title: 아이 — 질문
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the RIGHT. Asking a question: looking far up at a tall adult, one arm stretched up pointing with the index finger, mouth wide open mid-question, eyebrows raised.

items.title: 아이 — 우와
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the RIGHT. Amazed: sparkling star-filled eyes, huge open-mouth grin, both fists clenched in front of the chest.

items.title: 아이 — 의심
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the RIGHT. Not buying it: arms crossed, eyes narrowed to suspicious slits, mouth a flat line pulled to one side, looking up sideways.

items.title: 아이 — 웃음
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the RIGHT. Laughing hard: eyes squeezed shut, mouth wide open showing the missing tooth, holding the belly with both hands.

items.title: 아이 — 질문 (말하는 그림)
items.motion: 질문 그림과 1/8초마다 번갈아 나와서 입이 움직인다.
items.desc: Change only the face: the mouth is now closed in a small pouty line (as if between two words) and the eyebrows are a little lower. The pointing arm stays exactly where it is.

attach.label: 채널 프로필 — 오른쪽 위 안경 쓴 여자가 엄마
채널 배너 — 맨 오른쪽 팔짱 낀 여자가 엄마

items.title: 엄마 — 기본
items.note: 엄마의 기준 그림. 채널 프로필 · 배너의 엄마를 보고 전신으로 처음 그린다. 이후 엄마 그림에 전부 ②로 첨부한다.
items.desc: The mom must be exactly the same woman as the woman with round glasses in attached images 2 and 3 (the channel profile picture and banner): same face, glasses, hairstyle, hair color and sage-green sweater. Draw only her, alone, as a full-body character; ignore the other people in those images. 3/4 view, body and face turned slightly to the LEFT. Standing relaxed, hands loosely clasped in front, a calm gentle smile.

items.title: 엄마 — 다 안다는 미소
items.note: 프로필 · 배너의 그 표정. 아빠가 쩔쩔맬 때 옆에서 보는 엄마.
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Arms crossed, weight on one leg, one eyebrow raised high, a knowing sideways half-smile, eyes glancing sideways as if watching someone struggle, a small sparkle glinting on her glasses.

items.title: 엄마 — 설명
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Explaining clearly and kindly: one hand raised with the palm open as if laying out a point, the other hand pushing up her glasses with one finger, eyebrows up, mouth open mid-sentence.

items.title: 엄마 — 한숨 (이마 짚기)
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Exasperated: one hand pressed to her forehead, eyes closed, a long sigh puffing out of her mouth as a small comic cloud, shoulders dropped, the other hand on her hip, glasses slightly crooked.

items.title: 엄마 — 웃음
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Bursting out laughing: eyes squeezed into happy crescents behind her glasses, mouth wide open showing teeth, one hand half covering the mouth, the other hand slapping the air, leaning forward.

items.title: 엄마 — 충격
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Genuinely shocked: glasses sliding down her nose, eyes bulging, jaw dropped showing teeth, both hands up beside her cheeks, hair flicked up by shock lines.

items.title: 엄마 — 설명 (말하는 그림)
items.motion: 설명 그림과 1/8초마다 번갈아 나와서 입이 움직인다.
items.desc: Change only the face: the mouth is now closed in a small calm smile (as if between two words). Both hands stay exactly where they are.

items.title: 컷인 — 아빠 당황
items.desc: Facing slightly to the LEFT. Total panic: eyes bulging and looking away, clenched-teeth fake smile, cold sweat pouring down the whole face, a vein on the temple, trembling.

items.title: 컷인 — 아빠 충격
items.desc: Facing slightly to the LEFT. Jaw dropped to the chest showing every tooth, gums and tongue, eyes popping out of their sockets, hair standing straight up.

items.title: 컷인 — 아빠 뿌듯
items.desc: Facing slightly to the LEFT. Smug proud face: chin raised, nostrils flared, closed crescent eyes, huge satisfied grin, sparkles.

items.title: 컷인 — 아이 질문
items.desc: Facing slightly to the RIGHT. Innocent and relentless: enormous shining eyes staring straight up, mouth open in a big round 'why?', one finger raised next to the face.

items.title: 컷인 — 아이 의심
items.desc: Facing slightly to the RIGHT. Deeply suspicious: eyes narrowed to slits, one eyebrow raised very high, lips pressed and pulled to one side.

items.title: 컷인 — 엄마 다 안다는 미소
items.desc: Facing slightly to the LEFT. Smug and all-knowing: one eyebrow arched very high, eyes half-closed, a slow sly smile pulled to one side, a sharp sparkle flashing across her glasses.

items.title: 컷인 — 엄마 어이없음
items.desc: Facing slightly to the LEFT. Utterly done: dead flat stare through her glasses, mouth a straight line, a vein on the temple, a dark gloomy shadow over the upper half of the face, a big sigh cloud.

items.title: 배경 — 거실
items.desc: A cozy Korean apartment living room in the daytime: beige fabric sofa against the back wall, a low wooden table, a tall leafy plant, a window with light curtains, a few picture frames with blank contents, light wooden floor.

items.title: 배경 — 저녁 밥상
items.desc: The dining area of a cozy Korean apartment in the evening: a wooden dining table against the back wall set for dinner with rice bowls, soup, side dishes, spoons and chopsticks, three chairs, a warm pendant lamp hanging above the table, a rice cooker on a side shelf, a kitchen doorway on the right, light wooden floor.

items.title: 배경 — 밤의 아이 방
items.desc: A small Korean child's bedroom at night: a single bed with a star-pattern blanket against the back wall on the left, a bedside table with a warm glowing desk lamp, a window showing a crescent moon, dim blue room light with one warm pool of lamp light.
